i.norm: The supplier hands out bytes one at a time, in order: 2, 3, 4, then 5.

Read the first 3 bytes (2, 3, 4) as a little-endian value, leaving the 5 unread. In little-endian order each successive byte carries a weight 256x larger: byte 0 (value 2) -> weight 1 byte 1 (value 3) -> weight 256 byte 2 (value 4) -> weight 256 * 256
